component.name: stlounge
component.summary: Play ShaderToy shaders as eye candy

description.p: stlounge is a lightweight player for ShaderToy shaders, meant to be left running as eye candy: playlists, shuffle, crossfades, and shaders that react to whatever your desktop is playing.

ul.li: Runs ShaderToy shaders natively, including multipass buffers, textures, cubemaps, mouse input and desktop audio
A shader library with playlists, favorites, shuffle, auto-advance, crossfade and lock
Shaders that fail to compile, crash the driver or are too slow for your GPU are skipped
Add shaders by pasting or importing their ShaderToy JSON, or write your own

description.p: No shaders are included: import the ones you like from shadertoy.com. Each shader belongs to its author, and the app shows its author and link.

screenshot.caption: A shader playing, with the info panel and the library
A shader filling the window, with the interface hidden

description.p: Packaging release: no change to how shaders play.

ul.li: Available as a Flatpak, with app store information
The AppImage now runs on older distributions (glibc 2.35 or newer)
The desktop file and icon are now named io.github.durandarthur.stlounge
